evidence.quote: A number of members indicated that current and prospective economic conditions could well warrant additional policy accommodation
several members noted that the reference to mid-2013 might need to be adjusted before long.
some expressed the concern that, with the persistence of considerable resource slack, inflation might run below mandate-consistent levels for some time.
Strains in global financial markets continued to pose significant downside risks to economic activity.
the unemployment rate was expected to remain elevated at the end of 2013.
they agreed to continue the program of extending the average maturity of the Federal Reserve's holdings of securities as announced in September
